name: sudo-askpass
description: Lets Claude run sudo commands: each one opens a password dialog on your screen that shows the command. Your password goes straight to sudo; Claude never sees it.

cache.title: Password prompts
cache.description: every asks for your password on every sudo call. sudo reuses sudo's own cached login for a few minutes after you enter it once.

timeoutSeconds.title: Dialog timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long the password dialog waits before the sudo call fails. Cancel also fails it.
